title: Automated probe slicing and phased quarantine for rollout regressions
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: We currently gate canary and staged rollouts primarily on aggregate scorecards. This ticket implements a finer-grained evaluation layer that (1) slices reference probe sets into stratified cohorts, (2) computes per-slice signal and correlation metrics, and (3) enacts a phased quarantine of traffic or partial rollbacks when specific slices cross degradation thresholds. Goal: Reduce noisy global rollbacks by surfacing the exact semantic slices where regressions occur and enable automated, minimally-invasive quarantines (route-level or cohort-level) before full rollback. Approach: - Build a probe slicer that tags each reference prompt with metadata (intent cluster, token-length bucket, customer-sample flag, etc.). - Extend scorecards to emit per-slice delta metrics (accuracy proxies, hallucination rate, response-length drift, latency percentiles). - Implement phased quarantine policy engine: warn -> restrict (split traffic away from failing slices) -> escalate (isolate model variant to shadow) -> rollback. - Tie the policy engine into the rollout conductor so actions (quarantine, traffic-shift, rollback) are auditable and reversible. Success looks like fewer full-model rollbacks, more targeted quarantines, and clear traceability from slice alert to remediation action.
acceptance_criteria: Probe slicer produces stable slice IDs and stores metadata for each reference prompt
Scorecard exposes per-slice metrics and deltas over baseline for every canary/A-B/shadow run
Policy engine supports a 3-step phased quarantine (warn, restrict, escalate) configurable per-project
Automated actions (traffic-split, shadowing, rollback) appear in rollout audit logs with links to slice-level evidence
End-to-end test: induce a synthetic degradation on a single slice and verify that the system quarantines that slice without triggering a full rollback
tasks: Design data model for slice metadata and storage (include TTL and versioning)
Implement probe slicer microservice and batch tagging job
Add per-slice metric aggregation to eval pipeline and update scorecard API
Build phased quarantine policy engine and integrate with rollout conductor APIs
Create dashboard widgets to visualize slice-level deltas and quarantine state
Write chaos tests that simulate slice-specific regressions and validate actions
Document configuration knobs for per-customer/quarantine thresholds and SLAs
comments: 2025-02-14 - Ava Chen: Filed initial proposal after post-mortem with Payments team — several regressions were localized to a single intent cluster. Aggregate scorecards masked the signal. Proposing slice-driven gating to reduce noisy rollbacks.
2025-02-18 - Miguel Ortega: Sketched the phased quarantine state machine. Decided on warn -> restrict -> escalate to minimize user impact. Will prototype using existing rollout conductor webhooks.

2025-02-20 - Priya Nair (Product): Please ensure quarantine actions include customer notification hooks for enterprise tenants. Also add an option for manual hold so SREs can pause automated steps for high-risk customers.

2025-02-21 - Miguel Ortega: Implemented initial probe slicer (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/probe-slicer/pull/112). Basic clustering by intent and token-length buckets is in; still missing per-prompt customer flags.

2025-02-24 - Engineering review: Performance concern flagged — per-slice aggregation increases eval pipeline cost by ~8% on our perf cluster. Trade-off: higher upfront cost vs fewer escalations and reduced incident toil. Plan to optimize by sampling low-variance slices.

2025-02-26 - Design input (Lena Park): Dashboard prototypes attached show slice time-series and a quarantine timeline. Recommend color-coding by severity and showing contributing prompts when expanded.

2025-02-27 - Miguel Ortega: Integrated phased quarantine actions with rollout conductor. End-to-end smoke test passed on staging using synthetic delta. Next: add enterprise notification and update SSO permissions for manual intervene.

2025-02-27 - QA lead (Jordan Lee): Adding chaos test matrix to cycle; will run targeted regression tests across GPU and CPU quantized variants. Blocker: need durable storage for slice metadata (design decision pending).
